name: Shatoyaan
source:
Referred to as a saint by virtually every character in the games, she is the ruler of the White Moon that orbits the homeworld of the Transbaal Empire. The respect she is given by other characters (including [url=/c811]Tact Mayers[/url], who generally eschews the use of honorifics) is shown by the suffix '-sama' (様), which is used to refer to those of a much higher rank.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Shatoyan]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]

Referred to as a saint by virtually every character in the games, she is the ruler of the White Moon that orbits the homeworld of the Transbaal Empire.
